description: Pinned target repositories. Fetched into the cache (agent_eval.py fetch), never vendored. Chosen as mid-size, actively maintained projects in three languages myceliums parses: an application (fzf, Go), a library with many small modules (hono, TypeScript) and a library whose repository is dominated by docs and tests (fastapi, Python). Django (Python) was added for the outcome eval (#153): a large framework with many same-named methods across apps.

repos.name: fastapi
repos.index_note: docs/ (1,709 Markdown files in 13 languages) is excluded from the index: with it, `myc analyze` produced 23,941 symbols and its community detection had not finished after 13 minutes on the benchmark machine, before any embedding. The agent still sees docs/.

repos.name: django
repos.index_note: Only the django/ package is indexed (12,443 symbols, 828 files): with tests/ and docs/ included, `myc analyze` produced 41,842 symbols and 328,884 relationships and its community detection had not finished after 9 minutes on the benchmark machine. The agent still sees the whole checkout; every #153 question is about the django/ package.
